subject.title: [Bug]: Internal hooks (message:received, message:sent) 返回内容没有发送给用户

question: Should OpenClaw make `event.messages` auto-deliver for `message:received` replyable surfaces, or keep current `main`'s documented non-replyable `message:*` contract?
rationale: Current source drops the messages, v2026.6.11 docs promised `message:received` delivery, and the open maintainer PR fixes only reply-capable surfaces while leaving `message:sent` non-replyable.

options.title: Adopt replyable message:received
options.body: Review or update the open PR so `message:received` drains hook replies only when a safe reply target exists, while `message:sent` remains explicitly non-replyable.

options.title: Keep message hooks non-replyable
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue with the current docs as the intended contract, preserving message hooks as side-effect-only events.

options.title: Define broader message delivery
options.body: Design an explicit delivery policy for `message:sent` before implementation, because outbound hook replies need loop, target, and security rules.

recommendation.title: Adopt replyable message:received
recommendation.body: Review or update the open PR so `message:received` drains hook replies only when a safe reply target exists, while `message:sent` remains explicitly non-replyable.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` owns the active PR that already frames the replyable-surface boundary for this issue.
